title: General Knowledge Quiz
description: A short sample quiz to show the file format.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris has been the capital of France since the 10th century.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Iron oxide (rust) on its surface gives Mars its reddish colour.

questions.question: Water boils at 100 °C at sea level.
Who wrote "Romeo and Juliet"?
questions.explanation: Shakespeare wrote it early in his career, around 1595.
